notes: First group: Abu Dawud heard Shu'ba's own words («قال لي شعبة ايت جرير بن حازم»), so Shu'ba is the last link of that group

Two further sayings with their own isnads (Hasan b. Imara from Hakam from Miqsam from Ibn Abbas; then Hasan from Hakam from Yahya b. al-Jazzar from Ali) are written as their own groups; whether they are routes or separate reports is for a ruling (rule 11)
«يروى عن الحسن البصري» is the Hakam's reply naming a source of Hasan's report: left out as a remark
